# Session overview

## Before we start {#before-we-start}

::: {revealjs:layout-ncol="2"}

::: {.objectives}

- Write front matter that renders one document to two formats.
- Label a figure and cite it with a cross-reference.
- Check your work against the checkpoint.

:::

::: {.prerequisites}

- Quarto 1.12 or later.
- The project of session 1.

:::

:::

# Markdown basics

## Text formatting {#text-formatting}

Basic text formatting you use every day:

- **Bold** with `**bold**`, *italic* with `*italic*`.
- Arrows and operators keep their two characters in code: `->`, `!=`, `<=` and `=>`.

---

Code reads as written, with no ligatures:

```{.r filename="compare.R"}
if (x != y && y >= 0) {
  z <- x |> sqrt()
}
```

## Front matter {#exercise-front-matter}

::: {.exercise duration="15 min" format="solo"}

Create `portfolio.qmd`, a document that renders to HTML and to Typst.

::: {.solution}

The first solution sets two formats in the front matter.

```yaml
format:
  html: default
  typst: default
```

:::

:::

## Cross-references {#exercise-cross-references}

::: {.exercise duration="20 min" format="pairs"}

Label the figure, then cite it in the text.

::: {.solution}

The second solution labels the figure with `{#fig-plot}` and cites it with `@fig-plot`.

:::

:::

## Checkpoint {#checkpoint}

::: {.checkpoint}

Your document renders to HTML and to Typst, and the figure link works.

:::
